title: Once Upon a Team: Investigating Bias in LLM-Driven Software Team Composition and Task Allocation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating LLM-driven software team composition and task allocation using real-world GitHub developer profiles with varying declared pronouns (e.g., he/him, she/her, they/them, neopronouns) and analyzing selection odds and assigned task categories using logistic and multinomial regression models.

Evaluating LLM candidate selection and software engineering task assignment using developer profiles from five distinct countries (United States, Brazil, India, United Kingdom, and Nigeria), controlling for expertise confounders, and measuring disparities through statistical regression models.
